title: evm-explorer
tagline: 💠 Explore non-fungible tokens (NFTs) on blockchains that are compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
description:
A platform that enables users to explore, interact with, and analyze decentralized applications and non-fungible tokens on EVM-compatible blockchains. It is particularly useful for developers, investors, and users who want to engage with the growing ecosystem of DApps and NFTs.

This project contains a fully fledged Next.js based NFT Explorer capable of fetching nfts by:
- Collections
- External and connected wallet
Across all EVM compatible chains.
how_its_made:
This boilerplate has everything you need to start building a dapp:

- Next.js
- Wagmi Hooks
- Ethers.js
- Rainbowkit
- Alchemy SDK

## Supported Chains

The project supports all the major EVM chains:

 - Ethereum
 - Polygon
 - Arbitrum
 - Optimism

Back-end tools:

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/)
- [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/)
- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)
